title: He's spent more than four decades teaching at Harvard Medical School. Carnegie just named him one of America's great immigrants.

sources.text: Carnegie Corporation of New York - Sanjiv Chopra, Great Immigrants 2026
ABC News (AP) - The full list of the 2026 class of 'Great Immigrants, Great Americans'

caption:
He's spent more than four decades teaching at Harvard Medical School. Carnegie just named him one of America's great immigrants.

Chopra, a professor of medicine at Harvard Medical School and former faculty dean for continuing medical education, was honoured in a class of 25 naturalized citizens recognized ahead of the US's 250th Independence Day.

Over more than four decades on faculty, he also held posts at Brigham and Women's Hospital and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, received the 2012 Ellis Island Medal of Honor and became a Master of the American College of Physicians.

Chopra's four decades at Harvard Medical School show Indian medical training producing not just practicing doctors abroad, but educators shaping how medicine itself gets taught.
